$comment: Depth-3 reviewer: never prompts a human, never edits code; posts its own round via gh api (reviews, comments). Agent = the pr-review-toolkit fan-out and, in a validate round, the Chrome walkers; mcp__claude-in-chrome__* = the walk's browser tools, listed one by one (anything else from that server stays denied); Workflow = deep mode on the operator's opt-in only. Launched with --permission-mode dontAsk; anything not allowed is denied and reported to the PM. Writes only its findings file under {state_dir}/reviews/ (launch.sh fills in the real state dir). open-tab.sh appends the project's validation commands. Path rules for writes are Edit(...) (they cover Write); a bare Edit deny would block the findings file too — dontAsk already denies every edit not allowed.
